evidence.title: VantaUI - UI Library Built From Real Products

name: Iridescent Button
summary: Button component whose shimmering border follows the cursor, published in the VantaUI component catalog.
description: A component page in the VantaUI library: a button with a shimmering border that physically follows the user's cursor, documented with a live demo. VantaUI components install from its registry and the library targets React and Next.js; the page body is JavaScript-rendered, so only the title and description are readable as text.
